mount_hole_dia = 5.0

result = result - Pos(-plate_length/2 + slot_depth/2, 0, 0) * slot_box

boss_cyl = Cylinder(boss_diameter/2, boss_height)

    (-plate_length/2 + mount_hole_offset, -plate_width/2 + mount_hole_offset),
    (plate_length/2 - mount_hole_offset, -plate_width/2 + mount_hole_offset),
]:
    result = result - Pos(x, y, plate_thickness/2 + boss_height/2) * hole_cyl

base = base - pocket

hole2 = Pos(leg_thickness/2, leg_length_short - hole_offset_from_end, 0) * Cylinder(hole_diameter/2, bracket_width)
base = base - hole1 - hole2

part = base

        Circle(outer_diameter / 2)
